section_summary.extract_value: This section reports convergent validity findings for body appreciation, presenting gender-stratified correlations. In women, body appreciation was significantly negatively correlated with BMI (r=-.25, p<.001), while in men the correlation was not significant (r=-.03, p=.484), though a significant correlation was found with BMI² (r=-.15, p=.003). The section does not specify which study these results belong to.
